sentences.en: This invention was the result of years of patient experiment.
sentences.zh: 这项发明是经过多年耐心实验的结果。

sentences.en: Experiments will enable you to find out what is wrong.
sentences.zh: 通过实验你可以找出问题所在。

sentences.en: We found the failure of the experiment at the last moment.
sentences.zh: 我们在最后一刻发现实验失败了。

senses.zh: 做实验，进行试验；尝试，体验
